description: [phase 3.8 38b] GameFiles::list models FindFirstFileA with `*`, `?`, case-insensitive names, "*.*" = "*", "." and ".." first and the rest sorted by upper-cased name; it does not model the 8.3 short names a real volume also matches (a pattern `*.sve` finds `a.svex` there) nor wildcards in the directory part. test_loaders.py::test_listing_equals_windows checks 13 patterns over the install's files plus synthetic names against Windows' own FindFirstFileA (memory and directory implementations): equal. The game's patterns (saves, courses, theme text / pro / chr files) all name a 3-character extension of files with short extensions.
path to resolution: a listing test over a directory with a name whose extension is longer than the pattern's (needs an NTFS volume with 8.3 names enabled)

description: [phase 3.8 38b] The descriptor _open hands out is modelled as a constant 4 (-1 for a file that cannot be opened) and left in g_saveFd after the close; the value is the first descriptor the CRT returns in the recorded runs (U-0922) and g_saveFd is a sim-class object (every browser / autosave segment reads it). A process that held another descriptor open when the game saves would see another number.
path to resolution: a recording where the game saves while another low-level descriptor is open (none known)

description: [phase 3.8 38b] The port's refreshTerrain (saveload) runs rebuildTerrainGrid and sets the repaint byte but does not call Terrain::resetTerrain (the thunk 0x004a4f34: a Terrain.dll render-backend call whose result the exe never reads, U-0800). mainLoop's own two call sites keep dropping the whole function (tick.cpp kDrops), so only loadGame reaches the port's version; the three cov_a_flags browser segments PASS with it and fail one frame after the browser (g_tileWallMask) without the byte.
path to resolution: phase 4's Terrain backend gives resetTerrain a body

description: [phase 3.8 38b] listMatchingFiles copies a file name into a 0x64-byte frame buffer and then into its 0x64-byte table slot: a name of 100 characters or more overruns the frame in the original. The port copies the whole name (no overrun of a frame). The table cursor is unbounded in both (slot 100 onwards writes the objects after the table: covered by the many_105 / many_130 oracle cases).
path to resolution: a recorded run with a 100-character file name (none)

description: [phase 3.8 38b] cov_a_flags's recording listed 8 saved games: the pristine five plus ztut.sve, zdemo.sve and zedit.sve, copies of mood5.sve with one flag bit added (log/c3/c3fya_run.py, scenario.py cov_a_flags). They are not in the corpus; port/test/segment_files.py derives them from the install's mood5.sve (flag dword at file offset 0x44e09 | 0x8000 / 0x8000000 / 0x2000000, equal to log/c3/c3fya/fixtures/*.sve byte for byte when those exist). Any other segment whose recording ran with extra files in Saved Games sees a shorter list in the port.
path to resolution: record each segment's install file list in the corpus (segment_corpus.py)

description: [phase 3.8 38b] The browser oracle's pump takes one input batch per loop iteration (cmdemu's modal pump), so no iteration is idle: the button tips (30 idle iterations on one hot button, text-buffer writes only) and the idle redraw are not covered by the oracle. The three segments cover an idle-free path (5 and 11 dispatches).
path to resolution: an idle-iteration pump in cmdemu (a drain that dispatches nothing) and tip scenarios

description: [phase 3.8 38b] loadGolferRoster with both the theme's and the standard theme's data file missing shows an error through scrollTextWindow (a modal ui function, 0x0046de70) and goes on; the port stops there with MissingResource{"scrollTextWindow"} (no module registers it). The oracle compares the data image at the first call.

[phase 3.8 38b] loadGame / loadCourse / saveGame / loadGameBrowserScreen are called by mainLoop and the screens with the original's frame-local and stack state; the port version of loadGame leaves refreshTerrain's, loadWorldAssets' and loadInterfaceArt's results out (drawing / backend, called only when a module registers them; refreshTerrain is registered by saveload). rebuildTileCoverage is called with no argument in the original (the stack slot it would read is unused: the function takes none).

[phase 3.8 38b] courseActionMenu keeps three frame slots it never initialises (the blink counter, the dwell counter, the previous hot button) and a site -> record table whose entry for a site no course record names stays unwritten; the site byte of a record is not bound-checked (a byte >= 16 or negative writes other frame slots). The port starts the slots at 0, leaves unwritten entries at 0 and ignores a site byte outside 0..15. Only drawing (the plate blink) and the button tips (text buffer) read the counters; the recordings hold sites 0..15 with every record named.
path to resolution: a recording with a record whose site byte is outside 0..15 (none known)

description: [phase 3.8 38b] promptAndSaveFile writes the character file prefix (type record, phrase record, 16-byte skill record, the 8-byte marker) and then a PCX portrait: an Image the renderer composes from the sprite sheets and Image::savePcx writes. The port does not produce the portrait bytes, and does not write the render field it sets from a sprite object virtual call (0x5aa564) nor releases the UI object when its flag is set (the flag is cleared). The oracle stubs the image calls, so the compared files are the prefix.
